notablePrerequisites: Zabaz has at least one counter on it.
description:
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Zabaz.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zabaz, adding {C}{C}.
Zabaz dies, triggering its modular ability and Together Forever.
Resolve the Zabaz trigger, moving its +1/+1 counters onto another artifact creature.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Zabaz from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Zabaz by paying {1}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
